name: mcp-oauth-hello-world
description: Tiny OAuth-protected MCP server used as the self-test target for pabrik's MCP OAuth client. Serves the same 3 hello tools as mcp-http-hello-world behind a Bearer token, and implements the authorization-server side of the MCP authorization draft: protected resource metadata (RFC 9728), authorization server metadata (RFC 8414), dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), authorization code + PKCE S256, and the RFC 8707 resource parameter.
